expect_red: sweep: the frame rule -- the as-modelled pose is recognised, and any moved body turns picking off

mutations.contract: A binding is identity recorded against geometry sitting in the pose the model was built in. Face picking is therefore off outright whenever ANY body is away from its as-modelled pose.
mutations.note: The mutation checks the rotation and forgets the translation -- the half of a pose that a revolute joint never exercises, so the obvious fixture would not catch it. A prismatic body slid 60 mm down its axis would then read as `as-modelled`, and a face picked on it would be written as a binding about where it is not.
